name: Bloodmage: Waves of Blood heals a nearby ally from Crimson Tide ticks (#2240)
contract: Waves of Blood 681427: "Each tick of Crimson Tide now has a $681427h% chance to heal a nearby ally for $681427s1% of the damage dealt." Spell.dbc gives 681427 one effect - the private aura 354, which is nullptr in AuraEffectHandler (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:419) and has no core consumer - plus ProcFlags 0x0, ProcChance 10 and TriggerSpell 807652. 807652 is a real SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL with TargetA 18 / TargetB 31 (TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ALLY), radius index 23 = 40 yd and MaxAffectedTargets 1, and its BasePoints are 0, so the amount can only be forwarded by a script. The Bloodmage is the only friendly unit in range, so the single ally 807652 picks is the caster itself. Crimson Tide rank 504136 (SpellLevel 72, the rank a level 80 character owns) ticks every 3000 ms for DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms, i.e. 5 ticks per target, and its MaxAffectedTargets is 10 over radius index 13 = 10 yd, so eight fixture enemies all receive it. Two casts therefore roll the 10% chance about 72 times after the baseline is taken, which leaves a false failure below 0.1% (0.9^72 = 5e-4). The caster is in combat for the whole run, so Player::RegenerateHealth adds nothing and the only possible source of health for it is 807652.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Waves of Blood is a passive and is applied on learn
Crimson Tide is ticking on the first fixture enemy
Crimson Tide is ticking on the eighth fixture enemy
The caster never left combat, so no health regeneration ran
DISCRIMINATING: Waves of Blood healed the caster at least once
The heal carries a real share of a tick, not a zero base point
